content:
“You're a born survivor!”

**Born Survivor** is an Agility-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

Automaticallly use a stimpak with decreasing health.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★★★ | 3 | Falling below 40% health will automatically use a Stimpak, once every 20s. | 00330BA4 | 
| ★★ | 2 | Falling below 30% health will automatically use a Stimpak, once every 20s. | 00330BA3 | 
| ★ | 1 | Falling below 20% health will automatically use a Stimpak, once every 20s. | 00330BA0 | 

- Just like the Auto Stim legendary armor effect, this perk skips the animation of using a stimpak. This allows the player to heal in situations where they otherwise would not be able to, for example while firing a gun.
- Stimpaks used by this perk are prioritized in order of normal stimpaks, super stimpaks, and lastly diluted stimpaks.
